descriptor: An enterprise-grade AI Operations Dashboard for SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, and Windows servers, providing intelligent command center capabilities with human approval for production changes.

requirements.statement: The system must require human approval for any action that changes a production environment.
The system must automatically detect, diagnose, correlate, and recommend actions without executing production changes.
The system must provide confidence scores for recommended actions.
The system must present evidence-backed reasoning for all recommendations.
The system must log every decision and action for audit purposes.
The system must provide role-based dashboards for different user types.
The system must support integration with SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, and Windows servers.
The system must support integration with cloud services and enterprise applications through standardized connectors.
The system must provide operational summaries for IT Managers and Engineering Leaders.
The system must gather additional diagnostics when confidence is below 80%.
The system must escalate incidents to a human when confidence is below 60%.
The system must notify operators immediately of any autonomous actions taken.
The system must provide explainable AI recommendations for all users.
The system must allow configuration of confidence thresholds for actions.
The system must support rollback capabilities for low-risk, reversible tasks.
The system must provide continuous monitoring and AI-powered root cause analysis.
The system must reduce manual incident correlation across systems by 50-70%.
The system must provide a plug-in connector architecture for extensibility.

stories.title: Implement human approval workflow for production changes
stories.narrative: As an IT Operations Manager, I want production changes to require human approval, so that unauthorized changes are prevented.
acceptance: Given a production change request, When the request is submitted, Then it must require human approval.
Given a denied approval, When the request is resubmitted, Then it must still require approval.
Trust: Every approval decision is logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement approval workflow using existing ITSM tools. Log decisions in the audit trail.

stories.title: Log all decisions and actions for audit purposes
stories.narrative: As a Compliance Officer, I want all decisions and actions logged, so that I can audit them later.
acceptance: Given an action is taken, When it is logged, Then it must be retrievable in the audit log.
Given a decision is made, When it is logged, Then it must include the decision maker.
Trust: Every log entry is timestamped and immutable.
stories.task_guidance: Use a secure logging service to store audit logs with timestamps.

stories.title: Implement AI-driven diagnostics and recommendations
stories.narrative: As a DBA, I want AI to diagnose issues and recommend actions, so that I can resolve incidents faster.
acceptance: Given an incident, When AI analyzes it, Then it must provide a recommendation with a confidence score.
Given a recommendation, When it is viewed, Then it must include evidence-backed reasoning.
Trust: All recommendations are logged with confidence scores.
stories.task_guidance: Develop AI models to analyze incidents and generate recommendations with confidence scores.

stories.title: Gather additional diagnostics for low-confidence incidents
stories.narrative: As a DevOps Engineer, I want additional diagnostics for low-confidence incidents, so that I can make informed decisions.
acceptance: Given an incident with low confidence, When additional diagnostics are gathered, Then they must be presented to the user.
Given multiple diagnostics, When they are presented, Then they must include possible causes.
Trust: All diagnostics gathering is logged.
stories.task_guidance: Implement diagnostic gathering tools to collect additional data for low-confidence incidents.

stories.title: Develop role-based dashboards for different user types
stories.narrative: As an IT Manager, I want a dashboard tailored to my role, so that I can quickly access relevant information.
acceptance: Given a user role, When accessing the dashboard, Then it must display role-specific information.
Given an IT Manager, When viewing the dashboard, Then it must show operational summaries.
Trust: Dashboard access is logged by user role.
stories.task_guidance: Design and implement dashboards using a UI framework that supports role-based views.

stories.title: Enable SQL Server data access for AI recommendations
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to access data from SQL Server, so that I can provide AI-driven recommendations to users.
acceptance: Given the system is connected to SQL Server, when a user requests a recommendation, then the system provides an AI-driven recommendation using SQL Server data.
Given the system is unable to connect to SQL Server, when a user requests a recommendation, then the system notifies the user of the connectivity issue.
Trust: All data access attempts are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Utilize standardized connectors to access SQL Server data for AI processing. Ensure data is logged for audit trails.

stories.title: Enable cloud service data access for AI recommendations
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to access data from cloud services, so that I can provide AI-driven recommendations to users.
acceptance: Given the system is connected to cloud services, when a user requests a recommendation, then the system provides an AI-driven recommendation using cloud service data.
Given the system is unable to connect to cloud services, when a user requests a recommendation, then the system notifies the user of the connectivity issue.
Trust: All data access attempts are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Utilize standardized connectors to access cloud service data for AI processing. Ensure data is logged for audit trails.

stories.title: Enhance monitoring capabilities for continuous incident management
stories.narrative: As a Windows Server Administrator, I want enhanced monitoring, so that I can manage incidents continuously.
acceptance: Given a server, When monitoring is enabled, Then incidents must be detected continuously.
Given an incident, When detected, Then it must trigger an alert.
Trust: All monitoring actions are logged.
stories.task_guidance: Implement monitoring tools to continuously detect and log incidents on Windows servers.

stories.title: Implement incident escalation based on confidence thresholds
stories.narrative: As an Infrastructure Engineer, I want incidents escalated based on confidence, so that I can prioritize responses.
acceptance: Given an incident with low confidence, When escalated, Then it must notify a human operator.
Given an escalation, When it occurs, Then it must be logged with the confidence score.
Trust: All escalations are logged with timestamps.
stories.task_guidance: Configure incident management tools to escalate incidents based on confidence thresholds and log all escalations.

stories.title: Notify operators of autonomous actions
stories.narrative: As an operator, I want to be notified immediately of any autonomous actions taken by the system, so that I can monitor and respond as needed.
acceptance: Given an autonomous action is taken, when the action is completed, then the system immediately notifies the operators.
Given an autonomous action is taken, when the notification fails, then the system retries the notification until successful.
Trust: All autonomous actions and notifications are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement notification service to alert operators of autonomous actions. Ensure logging of actions and notifications.

stories.title: Implement rollback capabilities for low-risk tasks
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to be able to roll back low-risk tasks, so that I can ensure system stability and correct errors.
acceptance: Given a low-risk task is completed, when a rollback is requested, then the system successfully reverts the task.
Given a rollback is requested for a non-reversible task, when the request is made, then the system denies the rollback request.
Trust: All rollback actions are logged for audit purposes.
failure_paths: Rollback failure due to task dependency
stories.task_guidance: Develop rollback functionality for designated low-risk tasks. Ensure all rollback actions are logged.
